content.text: •loss of blood or fluid volume due to hemorrhage or fluid loss
•non-blood fluid loss: vomiting, bowel obstruction, pancreatitis, severe burns, DKA
: loss of blood or fluid volume →
ABCDEs, insert 2 large bore IV lines or a central line
warm, flushed extremities & skin, brisk capillary refill, bounding pulses, wide pulse pressure
Vasopressors if no response to fluids
IgE mediated systemic HSN reaction w/ histamine release
•recent hx of insect bite/sting, food, drug, or IV contrast
